description: Fork of exp512 (qk hardened argmax TinyMHLut). ONLY change: qk_lut param-matched reshape nap 3->4, tph 512->256 (entries/table 2^nap*tph: 8*512 = 16*256 = 4096, unchanged; total 89.39M). Third hard-argmax point on the qk wide-shallow-vs-deep curve at fixed 4096-entry budget, moving toward exp508's nap=6: exp511 nap=2/tph=1024 = 1.4862, exp512 nap=3/tph=512 = 1.4888, exp513 nap=4/tph=256 = ?. NAP=4 = 16 rows/table x 256 tables, ~512 tokens/row at bs=16. Row-coverage trend (nap=2 > nap=3) predicts nap=4 slightly worse; completes the curve. vs exp511 1.4862, exp512 1.4888, exp508 1.4840 (soft qk), exp475 1.4962 (all argmax ref).
